Privacy & advertising

Learning progress, bookmarks, selected language and appearance are stored in your browser using localStorage. There is no learner account or cloud progress database. Clear this site’s browser data to remove it.

Advertising

Ads depend on Google’s account/site approval, ad settings and available inventory. No ad impression or revenue is guaranteed.

Google advertising technologies · Manage Google ad preferences

Regional consent requirements must be configured in the publisher’s AdSense privacy and messaging settings before serving ads where required. This document does not itself collect consent.

Audio & external links

Daily-word pronunciation uses bundled MP3 clips where available. Other Japanese pronunciation uses your browser’s speech synthesis service. Depending on your device, that service may operate locally or through its provider. External translation and source links open third-party websites only when selected.

Learning data

Learning content is bundled with the website. Bangla/Nepali grammar meanings and formation labels are authored for this app. Vocabulary, Kanji glosses and example sentences include offline machine translation drafts, with curated core-word corrections. These drafts have not all received native-speaker review. The Japanese and English source text remains available for comparison.
